Only Finance Office budget updates count. I resolved the withdrawal chains first, treating withdrawn updates as if they never happened and restoring updates when their withdrawals were withdrawn.

The resulting calculation, grouped by record range, is:

| Records | Net effective change |
|---|---:|
| #0001: initial budget | $1,450K |
| #0002–#0400 | +$861K |
| #0401–#0800 | −$469K |
| #0801–#1200 | −$7K |
| #1201–#1600 | −$1,365K |
| **Final budget** | **$470K** |

These totals reflect each update’s status at the end of all records, not its status at an intermediate point. Non-Finance claims and administrative messages do not affect the calculation.

ANSWER: $470K
